## Target

- Runtime (MLX-LM, MTPLX, oMLX, AX Engine, vLLM or another integration):
- Runtime/dependency versions and hardware:
- Model architecture, immutable source/artifact revision and physical format:

## Evidence

Provide sanitized commands and results. Distinguish static validation, loading,
generation, requested modalities and MTP off/on behavior. Report unsupported
features and failures as well as successes. No quality or speed claim is needed
to propose an integration; include measurements if making such a claim.

## Proposed contribution

Describe the adapter, fixture, documentation or fix you would like to contribute.
